versions.content: No Architectural Information in Names Type: Valid Description: No definition of architectural or implementation information shall be present into names. Rationale: To increase the re-usability and decrease the maintenance of standard elements. Use Case: Creating different composition of components without changing any element name. Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: Naming Convention 1.0 from Powertrain Domain §1.4
